claims.text: No forecaster in the compared set shows a statistically significant improvement over a naive last-value predictor on Exchange.
DLinear is best characterised as decomposition linear baseline.

evidence.description: DLinear MSE is within one standard deviation of persistence on the Exchange benchmark.

limitations.text: Missing-value handling is delegated to preprocessing and not stress-tested.
Comparison omits linear baselines that recent work has shown to be competitive.

future_work.text: Reducing memory usage at input length ≥ 2048 without accuracy loss.
Pretraining on a mixture of datasets to test transfer.
